title: Account switch leaves the GIF panel gate and status-choices gate open on the outgoing session
trigger: Open the composer panel on its GIFs tab (or the emoji status selector), then switch to another account from the account list.
effect: PickerUi's Farewell is empty and leave_for_background only deselects the chat, so the retired session keeps stickers.gifs.open (and emoji.status_open) true. The background client keeps downloading GIF panel files and running GIF searches (sync_shown_media, maybe_search_gifs) until the user switches back, where sync_gif_downloads closes it.
fix: Give PickerUi a real Farewell that calls close_gif_panel and close_emoji_status_choices on the client being left, or make the gate a function of the on-screen panel mode only.

title: Reaction and status selectors force tab = Emoji without syncing the GIF gate
trigger: Open the composer panel on the GIFs tab, then open the reaction selector from a message or the status selector from the main menu without closing the panel first.
effect: tab is set to Emoji directly, so shows_gifs() becomes false but sync_gif_downloads is not called; the session GIF gate (gifs.open) stays open and GIF downloads continue until some later close.
fix: Make selector modes carry their tab (PanelMode::Compose(PanelTab) vs selectors without one) and have set_media_panel_mode be the one place that syncs the GIF gate.

title: Lock leaves the media panel on its GIFs tab, so the GIF gate stays open under the lock
trigger: Open the GIFs tab of the composer panel, lock Quill with the passcode.
effect: close_for_lock never closes the media panel; the panel is only hidden, so wanted stays true and gifs.open stays set; the GIF search/download work continues while locked.
fix: Derive the GIF gate from what is drawn (not locked and panel on Gifs), or close the gate in close_for_lock.

title: Viewer control visibility is five fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Idle in the viewer for about 1.1 s, move the pointer, rest on a control.
effect: hide_timer (task running), controls_hidden, controls_hidden_at, controls_gen, last_activity and over_controls together encode Shown / Waiting / Faded / Gone; hide_timer is a bool set before spawn_scoped and cleared only when the task body sees done.
fix: One ControlsVisibility enum { Shown{since, hold}, Fading{at}, Gone } holding the timer Task in the variant, so dropping the viewer or the variant cancels it.

title: Rotate/flip decode stage is reorient_pending + reorient_gen + orientation + rotated
trigger: Press Rotate or Flip several times quickly on a photo in the viewer.
effect: An Option target, a generation token and two result fields are set in different places (reorient_viewer_photo, finish_viewer_reorient, cancel_reorient, reset_viewer_item_state); correct today because every exit bumps the generation.
fix: enum Orientation { Settled{orientation, image}, Decoding{target, base, gen} } owned by the viewer item.

title: inactive_paused bool records who paused a looping clip
trigger: Switch away from the window while a GIF/loop plays in the viewer, come back.
effect: A bool beside the player's own play state says the pause came from window inactivity; it is cleared in reset_viewer_item_state but not by close_media_viewer.
fix: Fold into a PauseReason enum on the viewer's playback state (UserPaused, WindowInactive, Playing).

title: Album pin label clones the whole loaded history on every viewer chrome render
trigger: Open a photo that is part of an album in a chat with a long loaded history and where you can pin; play a video in an album or leave the zoom animating.
effect: viewer_chrome runs on every chrome redraw (up to every 100 ms while a clip plays) and each time collects h.ordered().cloned() for the whole history just to compute a label, so UI-thread work grows with history length.
fix: Compute album membership and pin state from the album's ids (a lookup by media_album_id) instead of cloning the history, or cache the label per item and session revision.

title: Shared Media viewer merges the session's current shared-media tab without checking its chat
trigger: Open the viewer from the Shared Media panel of chat A, then (notification click or deep link) another chat B becomes open and its shared media loads while the viewer is still up.
effect: sync_shared_media_viewer reads session.media.shared_media.tabs[tab] and merge_older takes items older than the first by message id; nothing compares shared_media.chat_id with the viewer's chat, so B's older items can be prepended to A's viewer.
fix: Store the chat in ViewerSource::SharedMedia{chat_id} and merge only when the session's shared_media.chat_id equals it.

title: Viewer delete availability uses the session's single message_menu_actions slot shared with the message menu and other windows' viewers
trigger: Open viewers in the main window and a chat window (or open a message context menu) so that fetch_message_menu_actions is asked for different messages.
effect: Each step asks fetch_message_menu_actions and the answer overwrites one Option<(chat, message, actions)>; the matching in viewer_delete_confirm keeps it correct but the other viewer's Delete button disappears until it steps again.
fix: Key the actions answer by (chat, message) in a small map, or per window view like WindowViews.

title: Viewer media-session tick is a started flag kept in step with a detached task
trigger: Open a viewer clip; the 250 ms tick task runs until the player goes away.
effect: None today: the task clears the flag on its own exit; if the final update fails (screen or window gone) the flag stays set but its owner is gone too.
fix: Hold the tick as `Option<Task<()>>` (or a `Ticker` enum Idle/Running(Task)) so dropping the owner stops it and no flag is needed.

title: Inactive-window pause of a looping clip is a bool beside the player's play state
trigger: A looping clip plays, the window loses focus (flag set, clip paused), the user steps or closes.
effect: The flag is cleared only in reset_viewer_item_state; the pause/resume decision depends on flag, viewer_loops(), player and window activity kept in step by hand.
fix: Fold into the player stage: `Playing | Paused(ByUser) | Paused(WindowInactive)`.

title: Profile viewer's owner lives in a separate Option beside ViewerSource::Profile
trigger: Open a profile photo gallery, close, open a shared-media viewer.
effect: profile_owner is set in show_photo_gallery and never cleared; every reader must also test source()==Profile or it reads a stale owner.
fix: Make the source an enum `ViewerSource::Profile(PhotoOwner)` so the owner exists only while the source is Profile.

title: "Share at" position stash is set even when the forward picker did not open or was toggled shut
trigger: Play a video, Share at 1:23 while the forward draft is on a different chat/topic or the message cannot be forwarded (begin_forward_one shows a note or toggles/closes the picker), then forward the same message by another route and use Copy link.
effect: share_at is set after begin_forward_one returns, so a refused or closed picker leaves it behind; the next Copy link for that message carries the old second until the viewer item is reset.
fix: Carry the position inside the forward stage (`ForwardStage::Selecting { draft, at: Option<Secs> }`) so it lives and dies with the picker.

title: Picture-in-Picture of another account never sees its message deleted
trigger: Open PiP for a clip in account A, switch to account B, the clip's message is deleted in A.
effect: pip_message_deleted requires the on-screen session to be the link's account, so the window keeps playing a deleted message (header says it goes when the message is deleted). Only logout or lock closes it.
fix: Look the tombstone up in the link's own account (background client session) or let the account's deletion update close its links.

title: Speed and volume changes reach only the current window's viewer player
trigger: Two windows each show a playing viewer clip (main window and a chat window); change speed or volume in one.
effect: set_playback_speed and set_playback_volume write players.speed/volume app-wide but update only `self.viewer.player` of the window in scope, so the other window's clip keeps the old rate/volume while its slider/label reads the new value.
fix: Apply the app-wide value in one pass over every window's viewer (`in_every_window`).

title: Message menu becomes invisible but stays open when its message is removed
trigger: Right-click a message; the sender deletes it (or the history window drops it) while the menu is open.
effect: The overlay returns an empty div (no DismissLayer), but message_ui.menu stays Some: context_menu_open() is true, arrow keys are swallowed by context_menu_key, the sidebar peek is held, until Escape is pressed.
fix: Close the menu when its message goes (check in the frame sync) or build the menu stage from a snapshot so it never depends on the live message; draw/dismiss from the same value that says open.

title: Chat-row menu becomes invisible but stays open when its chat is removed (also the top-person menu)
trigger: Right-click a chat row (or a top-people tile); the chat is deleted/left from another device while the menu is open.
effect: chat_menu_overlay and top_person_menu_overlay return an empty div without the dismiss layer, but chat_list.menu stays Some: arrows are swallowed (context_menu_key), the sidebar stays peeked, Escape needed.
fix: Drop chat_list.menu when the chat leaves the session (same sync that closes other chat-bound boxes).

title: Message menu mode is five fields cleared by ~40 call sites
trigger: Open the message menu (menu, menu_selection, menu_link, menu_item, menu_ui.page set in open_message_menu); pick an item.
effect: Each item sets `message_ui.menu = None` directly, leaving page/selection/link/item behind until the next open resets them; only some paths use close_message_menu.
fix: One `Option<OpenMessageMenu { target, position, page, link, item, selection }>`; closing is replacing it.

title: Most menu items close the menu without close_message_menu, so reaction options and the paid-reaction offer are not reset
trigger: Open the message menu on a message (reaction options are asked), pick Reply or any row, then open another menu quickly.
effect: close_message_menu is the only place that calls reset_message_reactions (Idle, paid.offered=None); the ~40 direct `menu = None` sites skip it, leaving the old message's options/offer in the session until the next fetch overwrites them.
fix: Make closing the menu one function (or the Drop of the menu stage) that also resets the session's reaction state.

title: One shared message_menu_actions slot is cleared by any window's menu, viewer or profile photo ask
trigger: With a message menu open in a chat window, step the main window's viewer or open a profile photo (each calls fetch_message_menu_actions, which sets the slot to None).
effect: The open menu's rows fall back to the local guesses (delete for all, edit, pin rows can appear or vanish) until the other answer lands and overwrites the slot with another message's actions that the menu then ignores.
fix: Key the answers by (chat, message) in a small map, or per window view, instead of one slot that every asker resets.

title: Secret-chat inline-bot warning stash is not bound to the chat that asked
trigger: In secret chat A press a switch-inline button (stash set, banner shown), open secret chat B without confirming, press Confirm on the banner.
effect: pending_inline_bot_alert survives the chat change (never cleared on sync_chat_ui) and the banner/confirm check only that the open chat is secret, so A's query text is inserted into B's composer.
fix: Store the stash with its chat: `pending_inline_bot_alert: Option<(ChatId, String)>` and drop it in replace_chat_ui / compare on confirm.

title: Pinned-bar Hide / Unpin all confirm closures run outside the window scope of the bar
trigger: In a chat window click Hide on the pinned bar (or open the pinned list and Unpin all / hide) and confirm in the kit alert.
effect: confirm() calls app.update without in_window_scope, so `this.history.hidden_pinned` / `pinned_list_open` are written to the main window's HistoryUi instead of the chat window's slot: the chat window's bar does not hide and its list stays open; the note also lands in the main window.
fix: Capture `self.windows.scope` when opening the alert and run the closure through in_window_scope / spawn_scoped (Asker).

title: Pinned list panel flag is not reset when the chat changes, and a lone pin has no toggle to close it
trigger: Open the pinned list in chat A (several pins), open chat B that has exactly one pin.
effect: pinned_list_open is a HistoryUi bool never reset on chat change (grep: only set in the bar/list handlers), so chat B shows its list open; with count==1 the bar shows the unpin/hide X instead of the list toggle, so the list can only be closed by clicking a row or unpinning.
fix: Move it to ChatUi (replaced per chat) or key it by AccountChat: `pinned_list_open: Option<AccountChat>`.

title: Chat peek is two Options (press and preview) plus a timer task matched by (chat, Instant)
trigger: Long-press a chat row: preview_press set, timer task, then preview set; release clears both from several handlers.
effect: Every release handler must clear preview_press by hand (chat_row, top_people, topic_titles, chat_list); a missed one lets the timer open a peek with the button already released.
fix: One `PeekStage { Idle, Pressing{chat,started}, Showing{chat,anchor} }` with a single `release()`.

title: Effect badge registries are process-global thread-locals keyed by bare (chat, message) ids
trigger: Click a message effect badge, switch account in the same frame; or leave a badge unseen/seen entry while switching to an account that has a chat with the same id.
effect: BADGES, REPLAYS and the overlay's WAITING survive an account switch and carry no account, so a queued replay or seen-badge note can apply to the other account's message with the same ids (private chat ids and small message ids collide).
fix: Key them by AccountChat/ChatMessage owner keys and clear them in the OnScreen replacement (or own them in OnScreen).

title: Music row play button uses the main window's open chat, not the message's chat
trigger: Open a chat with a music file in a chat window (pop-out) while the main window shows another chat or none; press play on the music row.
effect: With no main chat open the button does nothing. With another chat open, playback starts under that other chat's id (player.chat, positions key), so the row never shows as playing and a same-numbered message of the other chat is toggled.
fix: Pass the message's ChatId into audio_row (as voice_note_row does) and use it; never read open_chat_id inside a row that can draw in a chat window.

title: Message effect WAITING list is app-wide and keyed by bare (chat, message), not by account
trigger: Ask for an effect in a chat, then within 30 s switch to another account that shows a chat with the same id (shared group) with a badge for the same message key.
effect: The effect asked for under the first account can play (or be marked) for the other account's badge; at best it lingers up to WAIT.
fix: Hold the waiting list in OnScreen (or key entries with an OfAccount owner key) so a switch drops it.

title: A lost getMessageEffect answer is never asked again
trigger: The request for an effect description is dropped (connection reset, logout race) without an error answer.
effect: effects.requested keeps the id, wanted() filters it out for ever, the Waiting entry times out after 30 s, and the effect never plays for the rest of the session.
fix: Make each effect id a Fetch<MessageEffect> (idle/loading/ready/failed) with the loading arm left by the answer, the error and the owner going away.

title: Game score panel stage is a map entry plus a nested Option
trigger: Press Scores on a game card.
effect: Absent = closed, Some(None) = loading, Some(Some(rows)) = ready. Closing during load relies on a guard in apply to stay closed; a failed answer removes the entry (closes). Two windows showing the message share one panel.
fix: enum ScoresPanel { Closed, Loading(RequestId), Ready(Vec<GameHighScore>) } per ChatMessage, with the answer matched by request id.

title: Transcribe can be requested again before TDLib reports Pending
trigger: Press the transcribe button on a voice note twice in quick succession.
effect: request_transcription sets no in-flight marker; the button stays offered until updateMessageContent brings SpeechRecognition::Pending, so a second recognizeSpeech goes out (may spend the free speech trial).
fix: Track a Requested stage in SpeechRecognition (None, Requested, Pending, Text, Error) set when the request is sent.

title: Report dialog open flag kept in step with Session::messages::message_report by hand
trigger: Message menu, Report.
effect: MessageMenuUi::report_open (window) and MessageReportFlow (Session, one per account) are two sources of truth. A report in a chat window and one in the main window share one flow. Error paths reset report_open by hand.
fix: One ReportBox enum (Closed, Open(flow)) owned by the window slot, with the flow keyed by request id.

title: A late report answer is applied to a newer report of the same chat
trigger: Report message A, press Cancel while the box says Reporting, report message B in the same chat at once; the answer for A arrives.
effect: accept_message_report and fail_message_report match only the chat id, not the request or the stage: the box for B jumps to A's option list (or to Failed/Reported), and A's option ids are then sent with B's message ids.
fix: Give each flow a token (the RequestId of its current step) and apply an answer only when it equals the flow's token and the stage is the one waiting for it.

title: Report details text survives Cancel and shows in the next report
trigger: Open a report, reach the details step, type a comment, press Close; later report anything (any chat) up to the details step.
effect: The text area still holds the old comment, which is sent with the new report if the user does not notice. close_message_report never clears report_text (only a send does).
fix: Reset the text field in the single place that ends the flow (the ReportBox going back to Closed).

title: Save to Saved Messages says it needs a live account when only the user id or draft is missing
trigger: Message menu, Save to, Saved Messages while connected but my_user_id is not yet known (or the draft cannot be built).
effect: The else arm shows the demo note 'Saved Messages needs a live account' instead of an error, and the menu closes.
fix: Match live, me and draft separately and give each missing piece its own outcome.

title: wanted_reactor_tab intent can outlive its menu
trigger: Right-click a reaction chip on a message whose properties request fails or returns can_get_added_reactions false; later open the normal menu on the same message.
effect: The intent is only taken inside fetch_message_audience; if that never runs for this menu it stays and a later open of that message fetches a reactor tab nobody asked for.
fix: Carry the wanted tab in the menu's own state (message_ui.menu_ui) so it dies when the menu closes.

title: A failed reactor tab or viewer list shows 'no views' instead of an error
trigger: Open Seen/Reacted page when getMessageAddedReactions fails (Audience::Failed).
effect: The page has no rows and nothing loading, so it shows the empty text; there is no error and no retry (a tab already Failed is only re-asked by reselecting it).
fix: Draw an Audience::Failed arm with a Retry row.

title: Copy Option Link and Delete Item ignore a send error
trigger: Poll option menu, Copy Option Link or Delete Item while the request cannot be sent (not connected, chats path inactive).
effect: The menu closes and nothing happens; no status note (the comment relies on message_action_note, which only hears TDLib answers).
fix: Turn the Err arm into StatusNote::error like the other menu rows.

title: Message menu mode is spread over menu, menu_item, menu_link, menu_selection, menu_ui.page and right_clicked_item
trigger: Right-click a poll option or task, or a link, then open the menu.
effect: open_message_menu resets each field by hand; right_clicked_item is only consumed by take_right_clicked_item, so a right press that opens no menu leaves it for a later menu at the exact same point.
fix: MessageMenu { target, item, link, selection, page } inside the open-menu variant, so closing the menu drops all of it.

title: Poll option menu facts are an Option holding an Option
trigger: Right-click a poll option.
effect: Session::messages::poll_option_menu is None (not asked), Some with properties None (asked) or Some (answered), matched by chat, message and option on each read.
fix: Fetch<PollOptionProperties> keyed by ChatMessage + option id.

title: Drag poll loop is a bool kept beside the drag Option
trigger: Press a history row; start_selection_drag_loop sets selection_drag_loop=true and the loop task clears it only on its own exit.
effect: Two fields (selection_drag Some, selection_drag_loop) move in step by hand; a task that never reaches its last line leaves the loop flag set so no new loop starts.
fix: Make the drag one value, enum DragState { Idle, Pressed(DragSelect, Task<()>) }, so the poll task is owned by the drag and drops with it.

title: A held history press that never sees its mouse-up keeps a 15 ms poll loop and a stale drag alive
trigger: Press and hold on a history row, then lock with the hotkey (or switch chat by keyboard) and release. The MouseUp listener (history_message_list.rs:608) is registered only while the history list paints, so a locked or repainted-elsewhere window never delivers it.
effect: selection_drag stays Some, so the loop in selection_drag.rs:352 wakes every 15 ms for as long as it stays set (also under the lock). After a chat switch the next release applies the old drag to drag.chat, building the selection from loaded_selectable_ids(old chat). After unlock, a button-down move continues the old drag.
fix: Own the drag in a ChatUi value that sync_chat_ui replaces, clear it in close_for_lock, and end it on a MouseMove with no button pressed.

title: Closing a location request box leaves its lookup running
trigger: In a bot chat press a request-location keyboard button, then Cancel the box (request_share.rs:295/309/464 set request_share = None).
effect: request_locate (the lookup Task) is only ever overwritten (request_share.rs:125), never dropped on close, so the device location lookup the user cancelled runs to the end and writes its outcome into whatever request_share is open next.
fix: Put the lookup Task inside RequestShare as enum Locate { Searching(Task<()>), Found(..), Failed(..) } so closing the box drops it.

title: RequestShare::locate: None means searching, Some is the outcome
trigger: Open a Location request: locate=None is the in-flight stage, restart sets it back to None.
effect: A fetch stage encoded as Option<GeoOutcome> with the Task held elsewhere (MessageUi::request_locate); nothing ties answer to the share that asked, any later share receives it.
fix: Fetch<GeoOutcome> inside RequestShare that owns the Task (see previous entry).

title: Message menu is six fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Right-click a message: open_message_menu (reactions.rs:49) sets menu, menu_ui.page, menu_link, menu_item, menu_selection, reactions_expanded. Closing is `message_ui.menu = None` at 52 call sites; close_message_menu clears only menu.
effect: menu_selection (copied message text), menu_link, menu_item and menu_ui.page/audience_tab survive the close and are reset only by the next open; every reader must remember to also check menu.is_some().
fix: MessageUi::menu: Option<OpenMessageMenu { state, page, link, item, selection, audience_tab, reactions_expanded }> so closing drops all of it.

title: Most message-menu closes skip reset_message_reactions
trigger: Open the menu on a message, pick a row that does `this.message_ui.menu = None` (e.g. menu_media_rows, menu_gift_row, menu_block_sender_row, open_message_report) instead of close_message_menu.
effect: The session keeps message_reaction_options (Loading/Ready for the old message) and payments.paid.offered until the next open; a late answer lands for a closed menu. Next open refetches, so only a stale strip for one frame at worst.
fix: One close_message_menu used at all 52 sites, or tie the reaction request state to the OpenMessageMenu value.

title: Report and sticker-set dialogs are open flags beside session state
trigger: Report a message: report_open=true is set before reportChat is sent; the flow itself lives in Session.messages.message_report. sticker_set_open likewise sits beside the session's sticker set view.
effect: Two sources of truth (window flag, session flow) with the box reading both: with the flag true and no flow the box renders an empty 'Report' title; with a flow and flag false it is invisible.
fix: Derive the open state from the flow (flow owns the window that asked) rather than a second bool.

title: Report flow is session-wide but its open flag is per window
trigger: Open Report on a message in a chat window, then Report another message in the main window (or a second chat window) before closing the first.
effect: report_open is set in each window's own MessageUi but begin/report_messages overwrite the single session flow, so the first window's box now shows the second report's options/text and its Send reports the other messages; closing either calls clear_message_report and blanks the other box.
fix: Key the flow by window/asker (MessageReportFlow carries WindowKey) and let each window show only its own, or refuse a second open while one is live.

title: Rapid taps on a multiple-answer poll lose the first choice
trigger: In a poll that allows multiple answers tap option 1 then option 2 before the first setPollAnswer is applied by updatePoll.
effect: send_poll_answer builds the new set from the poll's current is_chosen (poll_answer_for_tap), which has not changed yet, so the second request sends only option 2 and replaces the first; the UI shows no pending state. A quiz can also get a second answer sent.
fix: Keep a per-poll vote stage (Idle | Sending{chosen, request}) in the session and build the next set from the pending chosen set; ignore taps while a quiz answer is in flight.

title: Vote tap is matched to an option by position, not option id
trigger: Poll updates (an option added/reordered via addPollOption or updatePoll) between the frame that drew the row and the click.
effect: The click closure captures `index` and vote_on_poll(chat, message, index) resolves it against the poll as it is at click time, so the vote can go to a different option than the one the user clicked.
fix: Pass option.id (PollOption::id) from the row and have the driver look it up.

title: 'Blocked' toast is shown when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Block a Replies sender while TDLib rejects blockMessageSenderFromReplies.
effect: submit_replies_block sets the success note NEW_CONTACT_BLOCK_DONE as soon as send_json returned Ok; the error answer then sets chat_action_error (users/error.rs:110), so the user sees 'blocked' followed by 'could not block'. The session's replies_block was also take()n before the send (connect/replies_block.rs:10), so a failed send cannot be retried from the box.
fix: Keep the box in a Submitting stage until the answer; show the note on the answer.

title: 'Load full message' has no in-flight state
trigger: Tap Load full message on a partial rich message twice, or when the request fails silently.
effect: The button stays live after the request is sent, so every tap sends another getFullRichMessage and a toast; nothing shows that the first is loading or ties the answer to the message that asked.
fix: A per-message Fetch<()> in the session (idle/loading/failed) that the button reads.

title: spoiler_revealed holds two meanings and is keyed by run index
trigger: Reveal a spoiler, or expand a long quote (quote_block inserts key with bit 63 set into the same HashSet).
effect: One set means 'spoiler revealed' and 'quote expanded', keyed (chat, message, run index, caption). Editing the message shifts run indexes so a reveal can land on a different run, and the set only grows for the life of the window slot.
fix: Two sets (or a map to enum Reveal) keyed by a stable run id, dropped when the message is edited or leaves the history.

title: Selection check animations are keyed by bare message id
trigger: In one window select messages in chat A (selection mode on), switch to chat B, whose first message has the same id (TDLib private and basic-group ids start at the same value in every chat) while the fade-out is still running.
effect: SelectionFx::checks (HashMap<i64, CheckAnim>) is kept until the mode glide settles, so for ~150 ms B's row with the same id draws A's check state.
fix: Key by (ChatId, MessageId) or clear on chat change (sync_chat_ui).

title: window_state_save_pending is a hand-kept in-flight flag
trigger: Move or resize the main window, toggle the sidebar.
effect: The flag is set before the 600 ms task and cleared only inside it; if update_in fails (window gone) it stays true and no later move schedules a save (the quit flush still writes the staged state). Already in the implicit-state baseline.
fix: enum WindowStateSave { Idle, Scheduled(Task<()>) } owned by FrameUi; dropping the task clears it.

title: Debug-build arithmetic overflow on negative (pending) message ids
trigger: Send a message so its local id is negative (message.id.0 < 0 exists, session_forward.rs:166); the row passes `message.id.0 as u64`.
effect: text_at computes `msg_key.1 * 2 + ..`, fast_button_cell `message_id * 10 + n`, poll_option_row `message_id.0 as u64 * 64 + index`: u64 overflow panics in debug/test builds (release wraps; Cargo.toml has no overflow-checks).
fix: Use wrapping_mul / a hashed id (or a MessageKey newtype with a checked element id) for element ids.

title: finish_successful_sends clears drafts only for the main window's composer
trigger: Open a chat in its own chat window, type text, send it. The poll (window scope None) drains Session::messages::draft_clears and compares it with the main window's composer_ui.clear_draft_on_success, not the slot's.
effect: The chat window's flag never matches; the draft_clears entry is taken and dropped, so the stored draft is not cleared after a successful send and can come back on reopen. The slot's flag stays Some.
fix: Key the pending clear by (chat, topic) in a per-owner map drained for every window, or have the send carry its own DraftClear token that the session echoes back, instead of one Option in the window-swapped ComposerUi.

title: Direct Messages box closes as if saved; the failure has nowhere to show
trigger: Channel owner opens Direct messages, turns it on or sets a price, presses Save, and TDLib refuses setChatDirectMessagesGroup.
effect: save_direct_messages takes the box and the button handler closes the dialog at once. PaidSave::Failed is drawn only inside that dialog (error_for(Channel)), so the refusal is never seen and the person thinks it saved.
fix: Keep the box open as a Saving stage of one enum (Editing / Saving / Failed) and close it from the answer; show the failure in the box.

title: Ownership transfer answer is not matched to the dialog that asked
trigger: Transfer ownership of chat A (Change owner, answer slow). Close the box, then open Leave on chat B and press Appoint another owner then pick a user, so B's dialog is Confirm{leave_after:true}. A's transferred answer lands.
effect: leave_after is read from whatever dialog is open now, not from the transfer's chat. Quill leaves chat A the user meant to keep, drops B's dialog, and the note names A.
fix: Carry the chat id and the leave_after choice in the in-flight transfer (one Transfer{chat, user, leave_after} value) and apply the answer only to it; a dialog for another chat is untouched.

title: Reply typed in a notification window is lost when the send fails
trigger: Type a reply in Quill's own notification window for the account on screen in a chat that refuses it (no rights, closed topic, channel) and press Enter.
effect: send_inline_reply returns false and sets a silent note that says to open the chat, but the window is unlinked and the Reply click is pushed only when another account is on screen. The text is gone and the chat is not opened.
fix: On a refused send keep the reply open with the text, or push the Reply click so the chat opens; make send_inline_reply return an enum (Sent / NotHere / Refused) instead of bool.

title: One-shot session outcomes are drained by whichever screen is on screen later
trigger: Start a payment needing 3-D Secure, a Copy Message Link or a forward on account A, switch to B before the answer, switch back to A.
effect: The answer landed in A's background session. poll_drains takes verification_url, message_link_result, last_forward and the error Options on the next pass of the new screen: a bank page opens, the clipboard is overwritten or an old error note appears minutes later. put_on_screen forgets only communities outcomes.
fix: Tag each outcome with the ScreenEpoch/ask that made it (as CommunityOutcome) and drop untagged or older ones in put_on_screen; or hold them in OnScreen so the drop is free.

title: Direct Messages box shows an old failure and one save slot serves all targets
trigger: A Direct messages save fails for channel C; reopen the box for C. Or Remove Fee for a user is saving while the box is open.
effect: Opening the box does not reset PaidSave, so the earlier failure line shows at once; saving is is_saving() of any target, so an unrelated save disables Save. A success answer for one target also sets Idle for another.
fix: Make the save a per-target map of Idle/Saving/Failed, cleared when the box opens.

title: A notification is dropped silently when its window cannot open
trigger: A notification leaves the queue and open_window fails (display gone, window limit).
effect: Pending was already taken from the queue; only an eprintln is left, so the message is never shown by Quill's windows and no fallback runs.
fix: Put the Pending back at the head of the queue (retry on the next display change) or fall back to the system notification.

title: An unlinked window still counts as replying
trigger: Type in a notification's reply field, then the chat is read/opened elsewhere (clear_custom_notifications) or Hide all is pressed.
effect: The window is unlinked and fading but Shown::replying stays true until it is removed, so held() blocks the other windows' fade and notify_start_all_hiding returns early for that time.
fix: Make replying part of the window's stage enum so unlinking leaves it; any_replying counts live windows only.

title: Notification window stage is unlinked + hiding + replying + waiting_for_input + hide_at, with the reply field mirrored in NotifyView
trigger: Any notification window.
effect: Live / Replying / Fading(slow|fast) / Gone is spread over five fields in Shown and Popup, plus NotifyView::reply and ::actions, kept in step by view events.
fix: enum WindowStage { WaitingForInput, Lingering(at), Replying, Fading{slow}, Gone } on Shown, set only by the manager; the view renders it.

title: NotifyWindows::ticking is a started flag for a detached clock task
trigger: Any notification window opens.
effect: ticking true means a task runs; it is reset only when the tick returns None, so a dropped task would leave the clock off forever.
fix: Hold the clock as Option<Task<()>> (idle = None) so dropping it is stopping it.

title: PolledRedraw owes a redraw as full: RedrawNeed + list: bool + conversation: bool
trigger: Every poll.
effect: Three owed-redraw flags that drawn() and decide() must clear together; a new flag needs each place edited.
fix: One Owed value (a small ordered set or enum of None/List/Conversation/Full(urgency)) with last-drawn times.

title: Mute and sound panels are open flags plus Options kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the mute menu, Custom, the sound pickers.
effect: mute_menu_open, mute_chat, mute_custom_open, mute_time and notif_sound_picker_open / story_sound_picker_open / defaults_sound_picker describe one panel's sub-view but are set and cleared in several files (mute_menu.rs, sounds.rs, tone_upload_demo.rs).
fix: enum MutePanel { Closed, Menu{chat}, Custom{chat, time}, SoundPicker{chat}, StoryPicker{chat} }.

title: Screen lifecycle is epoch + client_filled + goodbyes_due
trigger: Switch account, log out, full disk, restart.
effect: Empty / ClientOnScreen / GoodbyesDue are two bools beside the epoch, guarded only by debug_assert!, so a client put on screen in release builds before the deferred goodbyes ran is not refused.
fix: enum ScreenPhase { Empty, Filled, GoodbyesDue } with put_on_screen and take_live matching on it.

title: DirectMessagesBox price source is seeded + touched bools
trigger: Open Direct messages before the group's price arrived.
effect: Default / Seeded / Touched is held as two bools read in seed_direct_messages_price and the Save gate.
fix: enum PriceSource { Default, Known(i64), Edited(i64) }.

title: Checkout pays with a stale validated order after the fields are edited
trigger: Open an invoice that needs a shipping address, fill it, press Continue (shipping options appear), then edit the street or country and press Pay without pressing Continue again.
effect: Pay is enabled (order_ok only checks validated.is_some()) and submit_payment sends the old order_info_id and shipping option, so the order is charged and shipped against the address and price that were validated, not the ones shown.
fix: Make order state one enum on the dialog: Unvalidated, Validating, Validated{order_info_id, shipping options, snapshot of the OrderInfoData}; Pay requires Validated whose snapshot equals the current fields, and any field edit drops back to Unvalidated.

title: Receipt answer reopens a receipt box the user already closed, and is not matched to the message
trigger: Press View receipt on an invoice, close the box (or press View receipt on a second invoice) before the first answer arrives.
effect: The late answer sets receipt and receipt_open = true (applied by purpose only, GetPaymentReceipt), so the receipt box pops up unasked, or shows the first invoice's receipt for the second click.
fix: One Fetch-like enum Receipt { Closed, Loading{request_id, chat, message}, Shown(receipt), Failed } on the box; apply the answer only when Loading holds that request id, and close sets Closed.

title: Star reaction box closes as sent when the add failed or was refused after render
trigger: Open the Star amount box, then the balance drops or the connection path goes inactive before Send is pressed; press Send.
effect: send_paid_box clears the box first, add_paid ignores the driver Err. The refusal case sets a note, but the InvalidRequest/send_json_request failure paths leave paid.note stale or empty: the box closes, no Stars are added and no error shows (or a stale earlier refusal note shows).
fix: add_paid returns Result<(), PaidRefusal|SendError>; send_paid_box closes the box only on Ok and otherwise keeps it with the error in its own enum stage, instead of the shared PaidReactions::note channel.

title: A Star reaction whose commit request fails is dropped with an unseen note
trigger: Tap the Star chip and let the Undo window end while the commit request cannot be sent (send_json_request returns Err).
effect: take_due already removed the pending Stars, so the toast vanishes and the Stars are never committed; the 'Stars were not sent' note is written to paid.note, which only the next add_paid reads, so the user is never told.
fix: Keep the pending entry in a Committing/Failed stage until TDLib answers CommitPaidReaction; on failure surface a toast through the status note and offer retry or drop.

title: Passcode job result is thrown away when its window closed
trigger: Type the passcode on a chat window's lock screen (or press Turn on/off in the settings box) and close that window during the PBKDF2 run.
effect: run_passcode_job's Err branch only ends the job: a correct unlock leaves the global master key set but the app still locked and every window on the lock screen; a finished Turn off leaves enabled = true on a disk with no passcode, so the next lock cannot be opened. (system_unlock_wait handles this case, this path does not.)
fix: Run the result handler on the main window when the asking window is gone (as unlock_in_main_window does) so the answer always lands once; store the job as PasscodeJob::Running{kind, asker}.

title: Typing on the lock screen erases the flood-wait message while the button stays disabled
trigger: Enter a wrong passcode until Too many tries appears, then type in the field.
effect: Change takes lock_error, so the message goes while flood_until still disables Unlock; the screen shows a dead button with no reason until the countdown ends.
fix: LockScreenError enum { None, Wrong(text), Flood{until} }; typing clears only Wrong.

title: Closing side column keeps the previous account's panel target after an account switch
trigger: Open a user's info panel, switch accounts from the account list.
effect: FrameState::panels is app-wide, so last still holds InfoPanelTarget of the old account; for the slide-out frames the column draws that target against the new account's session (wrong or empty user card for about 200 ms).
fix: Reset the reveal in the OnScreen swap (put PanelReveal in OnScreen, or settle to default on account change).

title: Lock-screen Log out while a system unlock prompt is pending is later undone by the prompt's answer
trigger: Press Touch ID / system unlock, and while the OS prompt is open confirm Log out.
effect: The wipe starts and the lock lifts, then the prompt answers ok: global_unlock().set(master) and unlock_done run again for wiped accounts (second resume_after_unlock, intents, connection start).
fix: Log out sets PasscodeJob::Cancelled (or drops the receiver wait) so system_unlock_wait ignores a late answer.

title: Auto-lock and Touch ID switches show a new value even when saving it failed
trigger: Turn Touch ID on or pick an auto-lock time while passcode.json cannot be written.
effect: set_autolock_secs and set_system_unlock discard the write error; the UI shows the new setting, the next start uses the old one.
fix: Apply the setting to the UI state only after the write returns Ok, and show an error otherwise.

title: Checkout payment method is five fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Choose or enter a card in the checkout.
effect: credential_choice, new_card, card_form, password_prompt and prefilled are set together in use_new_card, choose_payment_method, set_password_for_card and dismiss_card_password_prompt; only code order keeps them consistent.
fix: enum PaymentMethod { NotChosen, EnteringCard(CardForm), NewCard{card, password: Asked|NotNeeded}, Saved(id) }.

title: Payments boxes are driven by bool and Option flags on the session
trigger: Open checkout, receipt or Subscriptions.
effect: form_loading + form + note + form_paid, receipt + receipt_open + receipt_error, subscriptions_open + star_subscriptions_loading/error/mutating + subscription_cancel_confirm are each one stage held as several fields.
fix: Checkout, Receipt and Subscriptions each become an enum (Closed, Loading{request}, Ready, Failed, Paying{request}, Paid) owned by the box.

title: Lock screen stage is spread over lock_error, flood_until, shake_started, logout_confirm and suggest_system_unlock
trigger: Lock, enter wrong passcodes, press Log out.
effect: These fields change together in lock_failed, unlock_answered, unlock_done, passcode_tick and the Log out buttons.
fix: enum LockScreen { Ready, Failed{text, shake_at}, Flooded{until}, ConfirmLogout, Verifying }.

title: Direct Messages box uses touched and seeded bools
trigger: Open a channel's Direct Messages box while its price is still being fetched.
effect: enabled, touched, seeded and price must agree on whether the slider shows the default, the fetched price or the user's choice.
fix: enum Price { WaitingForChannel, FromChannel(i64), Chosen(i64) }.

title: Delete snapshot is an Option cleared by two nested defers
trigger: Press Backspace or Delete in a card field.
effect: before_delete is set in a capture handler and removed by a defer of a defer so it goes after the Change event; timing keeps it in step with the input.
fix: Pass the edit kind with the input event (or consume the snapshot in the key handler) instead of timing a stage.

title: Width keeps paragraph, bytes, drawn and used in step
trigger: Scroll a long history.
effect: paragraph = None must leave bytes stale and only recount fixes the totals; drawn == 0 is the never-drawn stage.
fix: enum WidthState { SizeOnly, LaidOut{paragraph, bytes}, Drawn{..} }.

title: A finished plain group leaves admin.create_chat_dialog Some; 'closed' is only derived from the session's outcome
trigger: File > New Group, name it, pick members, Create. The session reports Created, so NewChatStep::Done hides the box.
effect: The kit box closes but NewChatDialog (three input entities, stage Creating) stays in admin.create_chat_dialog until the next open, and the NewChatCreation row stays in session.groups.new_chats.creations for the life of the session; nothing clears either.
fix: Make the dialog an Option that the Done arm takes (close_new_chat on Done, as drain_new_community_chat does) and remove the creation row when its outcome is consumed.

title: Cancel and Esc stay live while the create request is in flight, and the chat is made anyway
trigger: New Channel (or Group), Create, then press Cancel/Esc/X before TDLib answers (the Create button shows loading, Cancel is not disabled: steps.rs new-chat-cancel).
effect: close_new_chat drops the dialog but the request stays out: the chat is created with no Type step (a supergroup/channel never gets its link choice or subscribers step) and, for a channel, with no feedback at all. The Cancel did not cancel.
fix: Disable Cancel/dismiss while the stage is Creating with no outcome, or keep the dialog as a Creating stage that finishes the flow when the answer lands.

title: Title error is shown from two sources: NewChatDialog::title_error bool and view.failure NoTitle
trigger: Press Create with an empty name: dialog.title_error is set by hand; a server NoTitle failure sets the same message through the view.
effect: No bug today; title_error is cleared only by the title input's Change subscription, so any other path that edits the name (set_value from a demo, paste events that do not emit Change) keeps the error.
fix: Fold the name error into the stage (Info { name_error }) or derive it from the view only.

title: Subscribers step finishes as if Add worked when addChatMembers failed or there is no client
trigger: New Channel, pick subscribers, press Add while the driver refuses (no rights, no client).
effect: A note says the add failed, but finish_new_chat clears create_chat_dialog and opens the chat in the same call: the selection is lost and the box is gone, so the user cannot retry from it.
fix: Move to a Subscribers { adding: Fetch } stage and finish only on the answer; keep the box on error.

title: Editing the link clears Type.saving while the save request is still out
trigger: Type step: Save with a link, then type another character before TDLib answers.
effect: new_chat_link_edited sets saving = None, so the view is no longer busy and Save is enabled again with the first request still pending; a second Save sends another, and the late failure of the first cannot be told from the second.
fix: Keep the in-flight request id in the stage and separate 'refusal shown' from 'request in flight' (Type { chat, save: Idle | Saving(req) | Refused }).

title: AddContactDialog sent_name + sent_request + not_joined are one New Contact stage kept in step by hand
trigger: Window > Add Contact: Create, wait, Try someone else.
effect: Stages Form / Sending(request) / NotJoined are spread over three fields set in submit_new_contact (sent_name, sent_request, not_joined together, with a demo branch that sets not_joined and no request), take_new_contact_outcome and the retry button; the retry button must reset all three.
fix: enum NewContactStage { Form, Sending { request, name }, NotJoined { name } } on the dialog.

title: Create does nothing, with no message, while an earlier box's import is still pending
trigger: Window > Add Contact, Create, close the box before the answer, reopen it and press Create again.
effect: add_contact_by_phone returns Ok(None) because UsersState::new_contact_request is session-wide and still set; submit_new_contact then changes nothing (sent_request stays None), so the button looks dead, and the first import's answer is dropped for the new box.
fix: Show a pending state for the in-flight import (or cancel/supersede it) instead of Ok(None).

title: Corner preview windows end only on hover-out
trigger: Notification settings > Position: hover or click a corner slot, then close the settings page (Esc, tab or window close) without moving off the slot.
effect: notify_corner_preview(None) is called only from the slot's on_hover(false), which cannot fire once the element is gone; the sample popups (no timeout) stay on screen in that corner and the real notifications stay dimmed (windows.demo target 0).
fix: Own the preview as one value (Option<ScreenCorner>) cleared when the page closes, or give the samples a drop/close hook.

title: Tray 'disable notifications' flips only the account on screen
trigger: Two accounts signed in; use the tray/menu 'Disable notifications' while account A is on screen.
effect: set_desktop_notifications writes live.driver.session.settings of A only; account B's session still has desktop_notifications = true and keeps notifying (session_apply_messages.rs:457), and the tray checkbox flips back when B is brought on screen.
fix: Make the tray toggle an app-wide pref, or apply it to every account's session.

title: Badge pref is applied to the session before it is saved
trigger: Toggle a badge switch while the account dir cannot be written.
effect: The session value changes and a silent note says the save failed; the switch shows the new value until restart, when the old one returns.
fix: Apply after a successful save, or show the failure as an error and revert.

title: One Mute panel mode is spread over seven NotifyUi fields reset by three different functions
trigger: Open Mute, press Change on the sound, close with a preset, reopen.
effect: mute_menu_open, mute_chat, mute_custom_open, notif_sound_picker_open, story_sound_picker_open, ttl_picker and defaults_sound_picker are one 'which panel/picker is up' state; close_mute_menu, open_mute_menu and apply_chat_mute each reset a different subset.
fix: enum MutePanel { Closed, Open { chat, custom: bool, picker: Option<SoundPickerTarget> } } replaced whole on open and close.

title: Mute panel reopens with a sound picker still expanded
trigger: Header Mute > Change (story sound) > pick a mute preset or press X; open Mute again, on this or another chat.
effect: close_mute_menu clears notif_sound_picker_open but never story_sound_picker_open, open_mute_menu clears neither, and apply_chat_mute clears none of the picker flags, so the pickers open from the last visit show for the new chat.
fix: Reset the whole panel value on open (see the MutePanel enum).

title: Mute box closes as if saved when setChatNotificationSettings failed
trigger: Press a mute preset while the driver refuses the request.
effect: apply_chat_mute sets mute_menu_open = false and mute_chat = None before sending, so on Err the box is already gone and only a status note says it failed; the choice must be redone from scratch.
fix: Close in the Ok arm only.

title: Custom mute fields keep the last duration when the panel opens straight on Custom
trigger: Mute a chat for 3 days via Custom, then open a chat row's menu > Mute custom for another chat.
effect: open_mute_menu_for(custom = true) calls queue_mute_time_inputs, which returns at once when mute_time already exists; only the Custom toggle button resets the fields, so the new box shows 3 days instead of the 8 hour default.
fix: Reset the fields whenever the panel opens (part of the open value), not only on the toggle.

title: Mute time inputs are always built against the main window
trigger: Open Mute > Custom from a chat window whose box is hosted in that window, or with the main window closed to the tray.
effect: queue_mute_time_inputs defers into main_window.handle and builds InputState with that window; the fields are drawn in the chat window's dialog (focus/blur subscriptions belong to the other window), and with no main window handle they are never created, so the Custom row silently does not show.
fix: Create the fields with the window that asked (the Asker's window) and key them to it.

title: Scope/reaction notification settings are sent as a whole object copied from the session cache, without an optimistic update
trigger: Defaults dialog: flip two switches of one scope (or reaction sources) faster than TDLib's update arrives.
effect: Each apply_* clones scope_notification_settings, changes one field and sends the full object; the cache changes only on the later updateScopeNotificationSettings, so the second send carries the old value of the first field and silently reverts it. Same in apply_reaction_source/sound/preview.
fix: Keep a pending patch per scope (request id + the fields changed) and rebase on it, or send only the changed field when TDLib allows.

title: Sound picker closes before the setting is applied or even attempted
trigger: Defaults dialog: choose a sound while the scope/reaction settings are still loading, or the send fails.
effect: apply_scope_sound, apply_reaction_sound (and apply_chat_sound, apply_chat_story_sound) clear the picker flag first; the 'still loading' return and the Err note leave the picker closed with the old sound.
fix: Close the picker in the Ok arm only.

title: A file dialog answered after the passcode lock still starts the upload
trigger: Pick Upload Sound, leave the file dialog open, let auto-lock engage, choose the file.
effect: The spawn_screen continuation calls begin_tone_upload with no refused_while_locked or wait_for_unlock check, so the upload goes out and the picked sound is applied under the lock.
fix: Queue the pick as an unlock intent (wait_for_unlock) like the other OS opens.

title: Upload target is lost on an account switch while the upload goes on
trigger: Upload a sound from the picker, switch accounts before it lands, switch back.
effect: tone_upload_target lives in NotifyUi (replaced by the switch) but the upload outcome stays in the old account's session; on return settle_tone_upload sees Added with target None and only toasts, the new sound is not selected.
fix: Put the target inside ToneUpload::Uploading in the session so the two cannot separate.

title: Delete saved sound ignores the result and has no confirmation
trigger: Right-click a saved sound > Delete while the request fails.
effect: remove_notification_tone's Err is dropped with let _ =; no note, the row stays and the user cannot tell whether it worked.
fix: Show the error as a status note (and confirm like tdesktop).

title: A notification waiting for its avatar decode is shown with the lock state it had when queued
trigger: A message arrives from a chat whose avatar is not yet cached; lock Quill (or auto-lock fires) before the background decode ends.
effect: Waiting.locked and the already built notification (sender name and text from for_display) are shown by show_notification_as unchanged after the decode, so the OS toast carries the message text although Quill is locked (privacy).
fix: Re-read the lock when the decode ends and rebuild with for_locked_display, as show_notification_as is the single gate.

title: The ringing-call toast is tracked in one slot that is the account on screen's
trigger: Account A rings and is notified; switch to account B (or another call rings there).
effect: calls.notified holds one (account, call_id); announce_ringing_call dismisses it as soon as the account on screen has no ringing call, so A's still-ringing toast (with Accept/Decline) is withdrawn, and a second notified call overwrites the slot so the first is never dismissed.
fix: Track notified calls per account (map keyed by AccountKey), dismissed by the account that owns the call.

title: A previewed saved sound plays whenever its download ends
trigger: Press the play button on a saved sound that is not downloaded, close the settings, wait.
effect: The completion lands in pending_sound_plays and hand_out_notifications plays it unconditionally, long after the picker is gone, even when sounds are off or the user is in a call.
fix: Tie the pending play to the picker session (token) and drop it when the picker closes.

title: A typed inline reply is taken from the store and lost when it cannot be sent
trigger: Type a reply in an OS notification, then Quill is locked (or the chat refuses the send: no rights, closed topic).
effect: send_typed_notification_reply removes the text first; plan_inline_reply returns None when locked and send_text_snapshot can return Err, so the function returns false, the chat is opened instead and the typed text is gone.
fix: Take the text only after the send is accepted, or put it into the opened chat's composer draft.

title: 'Mark as read' on a notification posted before the lock still runs while locked
trigger: Notification shown; lock Quill; press Mark as read in the OS toast.
effect: drain_background_clicks runs MarkRead without refused_while_locked, so read receipts are sent for a chat under the lock (tdesktop only shows the window).
fix: Gate MarkRead (and Reply) on the lock; keep the click queued until the unlock.

title: A withdraw can run before the toast it should close is registered
trigger: A chat is read on another device right after its message arrives (Linux D-Bus path).
effect: show() runs on a worker thread and records the id only after the Notify round trip; close() finds no id in Shown and returns Ok, then the toast appears and stays for a chat that was already read.
fix: Record 'withdrawn' for the key in Shown so show() closes what it just made.

title: The signal listener thread ends for good when the bus iterator ends
trigger: The session bus connection drops (bus restart) while Quill runs.
effect: listen() returns when MessageIterator ends and is never restarted; NOTIFIER stays set, so toasts still show but their clicks, Reply and Closed signals never arrive until restart.
fix: Reconnect (clear NOTIFIER and let the retry gate re-make it) when the listener ends.
